pages.text: Containment is not destruction: you must keep the anomaly alive to study it. A unit that makes new ones at rate β, and is cleared naturally (γ) or by quarantine (q), makes R_e = ∫β e^{−(γ+q)τ}dτ = β/(γ + q) in its life. Quarantine works by pushing R_e below 1 - every outbreak then dies out - and the minimum field is q = β − γ.

The protocols, from the clinic and the high-containment lab: $(li)isolate - one specimen, one cell, sealed$(li)reduce contact (q) without starving the sample$(li)watch R, not the count$(li)never study what you cannot destroy. The Containment Ward's console is exactly this: hold R below 1, close to it for the fastest work.
In the Ward: stabiliser matrices, causal shielding, a defect core and a contagion map become $(item)Quarantine Field Matrices$().
A field that clears an anomaly faster than it can copy itself. It does not destroy anything - it only keeps R below one.$(br2)Made in $(item)Anomaly Containment Ward$().
